content: 'Awimereki
'Awimereki Yeruwahari nu'aya kaneyani, Tsikeni wareuxeiyamieka yu'iwama yumaamatsiemieme, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe yunaime yumaama niwemama:

«Xekeniwaruta'iwawiya yunaime teɨteri Tsikeni kiekatari: “¿Kehepaɨ tixenake matsi: memɨtexeta'aitɨani haika tewiyari heimana tamamata Yeruwahari niwemama, nutsɨ xewitɨ xeikɨa pɨtixe'aitɨaka?” Xekenaye'eri ne matsi nekanixe'iwatɨni».
Kepauka maamaya 'iwamama yunaime teɨteri Tsikeni kiekatari mɨpaɨ memɨtewarutahɨawixɨ, mɨkɨ mepuyuwaɨri 'Awimereki memɨparewienikɨ mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Mɨkɨ pɨta'iwa».
Mekani'ɨitɨani pɨrata tuminiyari haika tewiyari heimana tamamata Wahari-Weriti kiita mieme, mɨkɨkɨ 'Awimereki hipame 'axamemɨte'u'iyari kaniwaruta'inieni memiparewienikɨ.

Kaneyani 'Upɨra kiekariyaritsie, yupaapakie, xeiteteyarikɨ mana haika tewiyari heimana tamamata yu'iwama kaniwarukwini, Yeruwahari niwemama, Yeruwahari nu'aya Kutani 'etsimɨyumate yuti'awietaka mɨpaɨ katiniuyuta'una.
Yunaitɨ Tsikeni kiekatari meta Weti-Miru kiekatari mekaniuyukuxeurieni, xiu manuwe tete manuka mɨpatsie Tsikeni, 'Awimereki memanakurunatɨanikɨ mɨti'aitametɨnikɨ.
Kepauka Kutani mɨretima, kananutiyani yemuritsie Keritsini mɨtitewatsie, mɨpaɨ karima katiniwareukahiwieni:

content.text: xɨka mɨpaɨ xeka'uyɨni, xuyatsie tai keyenuiwa,

content: »¿Kamɨtsɨ 'aixɨa xete'uyuri 'Awimereki xemanakurunatɨa yuri xete'i'eririetɨ? 'Aixɨa xetewaku'eriya Yeruwahari niwemama, keyeme mɨreuyewetse wahepaɨtsita.
Nepaapa puyutami xehetsiemieme yutatuatɨ pɨxe'utawikweitsitɨa mariyanitsixi kememɨtexe'uximatɨakai.

Peru hikɨ 'axaxepɨte'uyuri, nepaapa niwemama xepɨwarukwi haika tewiyari heimana tamamata xeiteteyaritsie, 'Awimereki meta ti'aitame xete'ayeitɨa, Tsikenitari mɨtiwa'aitɨakakɨ, nepaapa mɨti'uximayatsiriekai nu'aya mɨxe'iwakɨ xeikɨa.
Xɨka hikɨ 'aixɨa xetewaku'eriyani Yeruwahari niwemama, xekeneyutemamawieka 'Awimereki hamatɨa, mɨkɨta xehamatɨa keyutemawieka.
Xɨka mɨpaɨ ka'aneni, Tsikeni kiekatari meta Weti-Miru kiekatari, 'Awimereki hetsie tai ke'ayeneni mekexe'utixɨtsitɨani, xehetsieta tai ke'ayeneni 'Awimereki ke'utaxɨtsitɨani».
Mɨya'utayɨka Kutani kaniuyuta'una, kaneyani Wehexi kiekariyaritsie paitɨ. Mana 'ukaitɨ kanayani yu'iwa 'Awimereki mɨmakakaikɨ.
'Awimereki katiniwaruta'aitɨakaitɨniri 'ixaheritsixi haika wiyari,
kepauka Kakaɨyari 'iyari 'axamɨ'ane meyenɨ'a 'Awimereki hetsie meta Tsikeni kiekatari wahetsie, 'ana mekaniku'eirieni.

Mɨpaɨ katiniuyɨni 'axamemɨwaruyurikɨ Yeruwahari niwemama haika tewiyari heimama tamamata, waxuriya memutayeurikɨ, wa'iwa hetsie mɨtinakekɨ 'Awimereki mɨwarukwikai, meta teɨteri Tsikeni kiekatari memiparewiekai.
'Ukitsi Tsikeni kiekatari tɨrikɨa hɨritsie mekanitihupakaitɨni, mana mekateniwanawairietɨwekaitɨni kemɨ'ane mana memuyekɨkakai. 'Awimereki katinetimani mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita.
Hikɨ mana kaninuani Kahari 'Eweri nu'aya Tsikeni, 'iwamarixi yunaitɨ, mana kiekatari hetsiena mekateniuwiya.
Yuwaxata me'anukɨneka meta kaxie takari me'utiketsika, 'ixɨarari mekanatinetɨani yukakaɨyari tukita. Kepauka memɨtekwakai meta memɨ'iekai 'Awimereki 'axamekateniutamani.

Kahari 'Eweri nu'aya mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «¿Ketita tiyu'erie 'Awimereki, ketitata Tsikeni tihɨkɨ para mɨti'uximayatsiriekakɨ? Yeruwahari nu'aya tamɨkatihɨkɨ, Tsewuri meta ti'uximayatsiriwame katihɨkɨ. Kamuxi niwemama Tsikeni paapaya ketiwa'aitɨaka. ¿Titayari 'Awimereki tete'uximayatsirieka?
Xɨka 'ikɨ teɨteri ne netiwa'aitɨakake, ne 'Awimereki nepanakahɨanikeyu, mɨpaɨ nepɨtitahɨawiwe: Keniwarukuxeɨri yunaime 'akuyaxima hikɨmɨ tepɨtatakwini”».
Tsewuri, kiekari mɨhɨritɨariekai, kaniuyeha'ani waɨkawa kepauka mu'enaxɨ kemutainekai Kahari 'Eweri nu'aya.
Hikɨ 'awie kaniwarenɨ'ani texaxatamete 'Awimereki hetsɨa, mɨpaɨ tiwarahɨawetɨ: «Kahari 'Eweri nu'aya meta 'iwamama Tsikeni mepu'axɨa yunaime 'axamepɨtewakɨhɨawe 'ahepaɨtsita.
Xekenanuku'uti 'ateɨterima xeyunaitɨ tɨkarikɨ yeuta xekeniwaruhupi.
Ximeri tau haneyu, kiekaritsie pekaniye'amɨkɨ. Kepauka Kahari mayeyani metsitamienike, 'ekɨtsɨ kemɨmatinake yaketineuyuri».
Hikɨ 'Awimereki kananukukeni meta kuyaximama tɨkarikɨ, mekaniuyuti'awieta yeuta Tsikeni heuhurakaku, me'ayenaukatɨ kuyaxiyari mekanakɨne.
Kahari 'Eweri nu'aya kiekari kitenie kaniuwekaitɨni, kepauka 'Awimereki memɨwatikɨ mewahupietɨ.
Kepauka Kahari mɨwaruxei mɨpaɨ Tsewuri katiniutahɨawe: ―Neuxei, teɨteri tɨrikɨa mepakahu. Tsewuri mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Hɨri 'etɨrieya pekatinixeiyani.
Peru tawarita Kahari mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Neuxei, hipatɨta xeime Yemuri hixɨapa mukatsie mepakahu, hipatɨta Xiu manuwe memɨtemaiwawe wahuyeyari'utɨa.

Hikɨ Tsewuri mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Hikɨta para mɨpaɨ keneutayɨki, kepemutainekai: “¿Tita tihɨkɨ 'Awimereki temɨte'i'uximayatsiriekakɨ?” ¿Mɨkɨ teɨteri mekatehɨkɨ pemɨwaniukima? Ketsɨari keniwarutakuya.
Kahari Tsikeni kiekatari wara'inietɨ 'Awimereki kaniutamieni.
Peru 'Awimereki pɨwaranukuwei, meyu'unarɨmetɨ yumɨiretɨ mekaniukaxɨrieni huyeta kiekari kitenie paitɨ.
'Awimereki 'Aruma kaniuyuhayewa, Tsewuri Tsikeni kiekariyaritsie Kahari meta 'iwamama kaniwarayeweiya.
'Uxa'arieka teɨteri Tsikenitsixi mekanayekɨne yu'etsarita, mɨpaɨta katiniutahɨawarieni 'Awimereki.
Hikɨ 'Awimereki yuteɨterima kaniwarukuxeɨrieni haika kuyaxiyari kaniwarayeitɨani, mekaniuyuti'awieta 'etsarita. Kepauka memɨwaruxei kiekaritsie mewayekɨkame, mekananuku'uni mewatakwinike.
'Awimereki meta hamatɨana memuhukai mekaniutinautsa kitenie memu'unikɨ. Huta kuyaxiyari, yu'etsarita memu'uwakai mekaniwarukwini.
'Awimereki kaniyumienekaitɨni mɨkɨ tukarikɨ, yunaime teɨteri warukwika meta kiekari naime 'uka'unaka naitsarie kwiepa 'una kaniutawiwiweni mɨkatitixuawerekɨ.
Mɨpaɨ metehetimaika teɨteri Tuxiyu Tsikeni mieme hetsie memakatekai, hikɨ mekaniyuti'awieta kakaɨyari Weriti tukita 'aixɨa mɨrekunameta.
'Awimereki retimaika kename muwa mehayetekai,

mɨkɨ meta teɨterimama mekanekɨne Tsarimuni hɨriyaritsie. Hatsa 'utituka kɨyexi kaniutiwiteni yunaiparie kaneitixɨrieni. Yuteɨterima mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Yaxeikɨata xeketeneuyuri kexemɨnete'uxei. Xeiya».

Yunaitɨ teɨterimama kɨyexi mekanawitexɨani 'Awimereki mekananukuweiya teɨteri memɨwayetei paitɨ, mana mekanikuxeɨrieni kɨyexi mekanitataiya. Mɨpaɨ mekateniukwini teɨteri Tuxiyu Tsikeni mieme taɨta memayetekai, xeimiriyari mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni 'ukitsi 'ukari.
'Ariketa 'Awimereki Tewetsi kaneyani, manata kanitahani kaniwarutiwiya.
Mɨkɨ kiekaritsie tuxiyu kaniuwekaitɨni, mɨkɨta mekaniuyuta'unakaitɨni, 'ukitsi 'ukari. Mekaneuyunani mɨkɨ tuxiyuta wapaitɨ mekananutikɨne.
'Awimereki tuxiyu manuwe kaniye'ani kaniwarutakwini. Peru kepauka 'ahurawa mumiekai 'itaiyake,
'ukaratsitɨtɨ kaneikatuaxa tete titɨxɨmekɨ 'Awimereki mu'uyatsie kaniukaweni, mu'uya kaniutatare.

Yapauka 'Awimereki yɨhɨweme kaniuta'inieni mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «'A'ixipara kenewatihani keneneumi'a, mɨpaɨ nemɨkaraxaxatsiwanikɨ: “'Ukaratsi kanimieni”». Hikɨ 'ihɨweme yu'ixiparakɨ kanitseni, mɨpaɨ katiniumɨni.
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi 'Awimereki memuxei mɨkime, yukie mekanakunuaxɨani.
Mɨpaɨ Kakaɨyari 'Awimereki katinakapitɨani, yupaapa hepaɨtsita 'axamɨtiuyuriekaikɨ yu'iwama mɨwarukwikaikɨ, haika tewiyari heimana tamamata.
Metatsiere, teɨteri Tsikeni kiekatari 'axamemɨte'uyurikɨ memɨte'ayukatuanikɨ, Kakaɨyari katiniuyurieni. Mɨpaɨ katinaye'ani Kutani ke'axamɨwaruyurikɨ Yeruwahari nu'aya.
